allocation_algorithm: Count fixed at 37,654. Step 0 (common donors): greedy minimal decluster of parent R1. Dots sorted by ascending nearest-neighbour distance (stable; ties row-major); each dot in order is removed iff it still has a surviving neighbour within 2.8 px (20 offsets with 0<d<2.8). Result (geometry-determined, no RNG): 1,914 donors (5.08%), survivors restored to min NN 2.8284 px. Donor sites are excluded from every receiver pool, so each arm moves exactly 1,914 dots. Step 1 (receiver rules, all on un-emitted H19-5 ridge pixels at d_cat>3 px, never on donor sites, deterministic, no RNG, no physics field): (a) poisson28: greedy farthest-point completion - each pick is the remaining pool pixel farthest from survivors+already-picked (argmax, first-index tie-break); (b) lattice4px: pool ranked by distance to the nearest node of a 4 px (400 m) square lattice at fixed phase (row%4==0,col%4==0 in array index), greedy pick skipping pixels within 1.5 px of an already-picked receiver; (c) strike: H19-5 local along-structure angle from a Gaussian structure tensor (sigma 1.5 px); each pool pixel scored by |cos(angle from its nearest survivor - local angle)| (1 = lies exactly along strike), greedy pick in descending score (lexsort tie-break row,col) skipping pixels within 1.5 px of an already-picked receiver. Donor ranking uses no label, no band, no physics field; receiver ranking uses H19-5 geometry + synthetic lattice only.
axis_choice_basis: Human instructed the agent to pick its own session axis (brief: 'Do not prompt me over choosing an Axis for the session, pick your own session'). Ledger holds 32 rows: MASS (3), PRUNE (7), CONCENTRATION (4), SNAP (9), RELIEF (9). The only brief axes never built are SPACING and TRACKB; TRACKB is Phase 2 only ('not a weekly-slot candidate unless the human decides'). SPACING is the brief's lowest-priority axis but the only remaining Week-1-eligible experiment, and the ledger gives it fresh teeth: the spacing lock decided SNAP (IR-88-32), densified refills tax RELIEF (IR-88-38/41), and R1 carries a 1,914-dot spacing defect to repair. Local ledger re-checked against origin/main (commit 1a694b0) immediately before building: identical, no SPACING rows anywhere.

decision_rules.if_abs_delta_lt_001: No evidence from one public-chunk receipt (brief section 5). Do not build spacing doses; carry the pairwise ordering as a prior for SUPPORT receiver placement and prioritise the R1 collar receipt.
decision_rules.if_all_three_le_R1_minus_001: Any re-spacing of saturated H19-5 support is harmful at 5% dose. Close SPACING; receiver geometry cannot beat the parent's own thinning - future relocation must bring new spaced support (SUPPORT axis).
decision_rules.if_lattice_wins_ge_R1_plus_001: Strand-agnostic regularity beats strand-following geometry. Overturns the uncovered-strand model; follow up with a lattice-phase control (phase shift falsifier) before trusting it.
decision_rules.if_poisson_wins_ge_R1_plus_001: Uniformity confirmed as the spacing objective. Promote poisson28 as the declustered parent for SUPPORT; test a larger decluster dose only with spaced ancestor support.
decision_rules.if_strike_wins_ge_R1_plus_001: Line continuity dominates uniformity. Follow up with STRIKE_ALIGN (structure-tensor strike agreement) rather than more spacing doses.
decision_rules.live_noise_floor: |delta| < 0.01 on the public chunks is no evidence (brief section 5).

dose.donor_definition: greedy minimal decluster: dots with a surviving neighbour within 2.8 px, removed in ascending-NN order (stable, row-major ties)
dose.donor_to_survivor_geometry: median 2.236 px, 6.0% beyond 3 px (small coverage holes); H19-5 within-3px coverage 86.38% (R1) -> 85.55% (survivors)
dose.n_donors_receivers: 1,914 each (5.08% of parent; brief change gate 1-50%)
dose.receiver_pool: 59,310 un-emitted H19-5 pixels at d_cat>3 px (donor sites excluded); only 366 pool pixels sit >=2.8 px from survivors, so no arm can fully restore 2.8 px spacing - poisson28 is the maximally spaced feasible set, not a strict 2.8 px disk packing

gates: Brief section 6 MUST gates only: format vs sample_submission.tif, zero catalogue mass, min d_cat>3 px asserted (parent R1 is gate-clean), SHA-256 not in ledger, parent-diff recorded, re-read from disk. Hide-and-recover PROXY (degenerate 0.0 for any >3 px file, IR-88-20/35), SGMC control, block CV and leakage canaries are REPORT ONLY. Geometric-score canaries (donor NN + three receiver scores) are computed on the standard seed-20/30 hidden-positive split; symmetric AUC >0.90 means stop and investigate (brief section 6).

parent.label: R1
parent.live_score_evidence: R1 has no RECEIPT. Its grandparent R0 live 0.2778 is CLAIM (no receipt in ledger/). All deltas below are MODEL vs R1, never a score.
parent.spacing_defect: min NN 1.000 px; 3,635 dots (9.65%) below the 2.8 px R0 spacing; greedy minimal decluster removes 1,914 (5.08%) and restores min NN 2.8284 px
parent.why_not_R0: Brief v2 section 4.4 requires >=3 px from the catalogue for every non-PRUNE axis. R0 carries 2,171 dots at 2<d_cat<=3 px, so a SPACING edit of R0 would be unspendable HOLD like the earlier R0-based MASS/CONCENTRATION/SNAP/RELIEF families (IR-88-33 precedent). R0 is additionally already perfect Poisson-disk 2.8 px spacing (min NN 2.8284), so it offers no spacing defect to repair - only a pattern to break. R1 is rebuilt from the pinned lineage and BOTH published SHA-256 values are asserted before editing; any mismatch aborts the build.

support_constraint: All receivers lie on the parent's own H19-5 ridge support at d_cat>3 px. No ancestor (H16-1/H19-4) pixels, no off-ridge pixels: this isolates receiver GEOMETRY from receiver SUPPORT (which is the proposed SUPPORT axis, not built here).

variants_fixed_before_any_proxy.rationale: Primary. Greedy farthest-point completion is the maximally uniform feasible set (receiver-survivor median 2.236 px vs 1.0 px for the other arms): it should recover the most uncovered strand length per dot (IR-88-41 currency) and reverse the densification tax measured on RELIEF adds (0.04-0.07 TP densified vs 0.11-0.16 TP spaced, IR-88-38). Magnitude kept small because only 366/1,914 receivers reach >=2.8 px - most remain partly densified.
variants_fixed_before_any_proxy.receiver_rule: greedy farthest-point from survivors+picked on the 59,310-pixel pool

variants_fixed_before_any_proxy.rationale: Negative control for strand-agnostic regularity. Lattice-anchored receivers (median lattice distance 0.0 px) ignore strand geometry and land at median 1.0 px from survivors (fully densified) while paying the same donor-removal cost. Expected to lose to poisson28 by about the densification gap. Period 4 px = 400 m coincides with the GeoDAWN flight-line spacing - phase fixed at (0,0), never tuned.
variants_fixed_before_any_proxy.receiver_rule: rank pool by distance to 4 px lattice node (phase 0,0), greedy pick with 1.5 px receiver exclusion

variants_fixed_before_any_proxy.rationale: Line-continuity arm. Receivers lie exactly along local H19-5 strike from their nearest survivor (median |cos| 1.000 vs 0.85-0.89 for the others), which should earn multi-pixel line credit T where truth is line-like (brief section 2 lowers the bar for lines). Centered at zero because along-strike adjacency also risks the IR-88-32 bunching failure (adjacent dots on one strand open 4-6 px gaps elsewhere) - this arm measures which effect wins.
variants_fixed_before_any_proxy.receiver_rule: rank pool by |cos| along-strike alignment (structure tensor sigma 1.5), greedy pick with 1.5 px receiver exclusion
